title: INFRA — /sprint-next: show next planned sprint title + rationale from queue
description: When queue is empty, operator has no visibility into what Claude Code will work on next. /sprint-next shows top pending item with title, block, priority, rationale, and queue depth. Shows 'queue empty — run /replenish' when no pending items.
